hooks.command: bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; inp=$(cat); if [ -z "$inp" ]; then inp="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; fi; path=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | tr -d "\r" | tr "\134" "/"); if printf "%s" "$path" | grep -qE "(^|/)(dist|build|[.]next|node_modules|coverage|target|vendor)/"; then echo "Blocked: edit to a generated directory ($path)" >&2; exit 2; fi'

if [ "$n" -gt 6500 ]; then echo "Blocked: a ${n}-byte command - on a Windows/Git-Bash host the Bash transport corrupts a command past a fixed offset near 7.5 KB (measured): write the payload to a file (Write tool) and run it by path, or split the call" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; if printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|([:space:]])cat[[:space:]][^|;&]*>>?[[:space:]]*[^&[:space:]][^|;&]*[^<]<<[^<]|(^|[;&|([:space:]])cat([[:space:]][^|;&]*)?[^<]<<[^<][^|;&]*>>?[[:space:]]*[^&[:space:]]|[^<]<<[^<][^|]*[|][[:space:]]*tee[[:space:]]|(^|[;&|([:space:]])tee([[:space:]][^|;&]*)?[^<]<<[^<]"; then echo "Blocked: a cat/tee heredoc with a file target - documents go through the Write tool; a script goes to a scratchpad file run by path" >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$cmd" in *cd*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; q=$(printf "\047"); d=$(printf "\042"); b=$(printf "\134"); k=$(printf "\140"); nl=$(printf "\nx"); nl="${nl%x}"; shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null; p=$(printf "%s" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" | tr "\134" "/"); LC_ALL=C; s="${cmd%%"<<"*}"; cp=1; n=0; m=""; u=""; h=""; while [ -n "$s" ]; do if [ -n "$m" ]; then a="${s%%["$d$b"]*}"; s="${s:${#a}}"; case "${s:0:1}" in "$b") s="${s:1}";; *) m="";; esac; s="${s:1}"; continue; fi; w="$cp"; if [ -n "$cp" ]; then cp=""; s="${s#"${s%%[![:blank:]]*}"}"; case "$n${s:0:3}" in "0{"|"0{"[[:space:]]*) s="${s:1}"; cp=1; continue;; 0cd|0cd[[:blank:]]*) if [ -z "$h" ]; then h=$(printf "%s" "$inp" | jq -r ".cwd // empty" | tr -d "\r"); [ -n "$h" ] || h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; h=$(printf "%s" "$h" | tr "\134" "/"); h=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$h" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); [ -n "$h" ] || exit 0; c="$h"; o=$(CDPATH= cd -- "${p:-$h}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); [ -n "$o" ] || o="$h"; fi; r="${s#cd}"; r="${r#"${r%%[![:blank:]]*}"}"; g=""; x=""; case "$r" in "$q"*) t="${r#"$q"}"; case "$t" in *"$q"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; t="${t%%"$q"*}"; r="${r#"$q$t$q"}";; "$d"*) t="${r#"$d"}"; case "$t" in *"$d"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; t="${t%%"$d"*}"; r="${r#"$d$t$d"}"; x=1;; *) t="${r%%[[:space:];&|<>()]*}"; r="${r#"$t"}"; g=1; x=1;; esac; s="$r"; r="${r#"${r%%[![:blank:]]*}"}"; case "$r" in ""|"&&"*|";"*|"$nl"*) ;; *) t="$b";; esac; case "$t" in *"$q"*|*"$d"*|*"$b"*) c=""; continue;; esac; if [ -n "$g" ]; then case "$t" in "~") t="$HOME";; "~/"*) t="$HOME/${t#"~/"}";; esac; [ -n "$t" ] || t="$HOME"; fi; if [ -n "$x" ]; then if [ -n "$p" ]; then t="${t//"\${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/$p}"; t="${t//"\$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/$p}"; fi; if [ -n "$HOME" ]; then t="${t//"\${HOME}"/$HOME}"; t="${t//"\$HOME"/$HOME}"; fi; fi; case "$t" in ""|"-"|*"$"*|*"$k"*) c=""; continue;; esac; case "$c$t" in /*) ;; *) continue;; esac; r=$([ -n "$g" ] || set -f; IFS=; CDPATH= cd -- "${c:-/}" 2>/dev/null && CDPATH= cd -- $t 2>/dev/null && pwd -P); case "$r" in "$h"|"$o") c="$r"; continue;; esac; echo "Blocked: cd ($t) moves the session cwd for every later call - keep it: absolute paths, git -C DIR, a tool dir flag, or a subshell ( cd DIR && ... ); a cd into the cwd or the project root passes" >&2; exit 2;; esac; fi; a="${s%%["$q$d$b$k$nl"";&|()#"]*}"; s="${s:${#a}}"; case "${s:0:2}" in "$q"*) s="${s:1}"; a="${s%%"$q"*}"; [ "${#a}" -lt "${#s}" ] || exit 0; s="${s:${#a}+1}";; "$d"*) s="${s:1}"; m=1;; "$b"*) s="${s:1}"; s="${s:1}";; "("*) s="${s:1}"; n=$((n+1));; ")"*) s="${s:1}"; n=$((n-1));; "$k"*) s="${s:1}"; if [ -n "$u" ]; then u=""; n=$((n-1)); else u=1; n=$((n+1)); fi;; "&&"|"||") s="${s:2}"; cp=1;; ";"*|"$nl"*) s="${s:1}"; cp=1;; "#"*) case "$w$a" in 1|*[[:blank:]]) a="${s%%"$nl"*}"; s="${s:${#a}}";; *) s="${s:1}";; esac;; *) s="${s:1}";; esac; done; exit 0'
bash -c 'command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(cat | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" | tr -d "\r"); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac'
